title: 第24章 黑市动人心，林神捕疯了？！（3k）
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
鬼市外围，一处阴暗的街角。

    几个缩在阴影里的汉子正盯着不远处的一道身影。

    “老大，这小子面生得很，身上绝对有大货！”一个瘦猴模样的汉子压低声音，眼中满是贪婪，“要不要兄弟们跟上去，把他给……”

    旁边一个脸上戴着面具的男人眉头微皱，似乎在权衡。

    他就是这片黑市外围的地头蛇，青蛇帮的老大。

    “有些不对劲。”旁边另一个老成些的汉子摇了摇头，

    “这小子敢孤身一人在鬼市露这么大的财，步伐又这么稳，说不定是个硬茬子。咱们还是小心为妙。”

    面具男闻言冷笑一声：“硬茬子？一个乳臭未干的小白脸能有多硬？

    在黑市里面不能动手，这是运行到现在的规矩。

    但只要出了黑市门口，那就是生死有命，富贵在天了。

    所以他们这个靠劫财为生的帮派，也是运应而生，而今天这个目标看起来倒是有些不一般。

    眼见那青年离开黑市门口，面具男开口:

    “走，跟上去。”

    听闻老大的话，几个青蛇帮的喽啰立刻兴奋地跟了上去。

    而留在原地的几个眼线对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了一丝疑虑，他们决定先按兵不动，跟在远处看看情况。

    ……

    陈然的脚步声不急不缓，在空旷的隧道里回荡。

    五道人影从黑暗中窜出，前后包夹，将陈然堵在了一处满是积水的死胡同里。

    为首的正是青蛇帮的老大崔海。

    他手里提着一把厚背鬼头刀，满脸横肉，眼底闪烁着毫不掩饰的贪婪与杀意。

    他身后跟着四个手持利刃的喽啰，死死盯着陈然腰间的布包。

    “跑啊，怎么不跑了？”

    崔海冷笑连连，鬼头刀在厚实的掌心拍了拍。

    “小子，生面孔吧？敢在鬼市露这么大的财，连命都不要了。”

    陈然停下脚步。

    他缓缓转过身。

    宽大的斗笠遮住了他的大半张脸。

    “把身上的银票，还有背上的东西，全都交出来。老子今天心情好，留你一具全尸。”

    崔海吐了口唾沫，刀尖直指陈然的面门，语气张狂至极。

    旁边那个瘦猴模样的喽啰上下打量着陈然，淫笑出声。

    “老大，我看这小子细皮嫩肉的，不如扒光了转手卖几次，再送他上路……”

    话音未落。

    陈然缓缓叹了口气。

    “唉，这个世道。”

    陈然自认为不是一个好人，但也绝对没有这么恶。

    怪不得朝廷内部人心动乱，就连这种杀人越货的买卖都敢在京城脚下干。

    可想而知现在内部贪污腐败到了极点，黑市肯定是打过招呼的，不会有捕快去管。

    但也不是没有好处，至少也确定了这处地界没有人管。

    他伸出右手，解开背上的破麻布。

    “我正愁买这把刀，把身上的积蓄都花光了。”

    陈然的手掌，稳稳地握住了黑铁长刀粗糙的刀柄。

    “既然你们上赶着来送钱，那我就不客气了。”

    “找死！”

    崔海勃然大怒。

    八品武者的气血瞬间爆发，浑身肌肉虬结。

    他双手握住鬼头刀，双腿猛地蹬地，整个人如同下山猛虎般扑向陈然。

    鬼头刀刮着凄厉的风声，朝着陈然的脑袋力劈而下。

    刀势极其凶猛，没有丝毫留手。

    与此同时，另外四个喽啰也配合得天衣无缝。他们挥舞着短刀和长刺，从四个不同的方向封死了陈然所有的退路，招招直奔要害。

    面对五人的绝杀围攻，陈然站在原地，纹丝不动。

    直到崔海的鬼头刀即将劈碎他头上的斗笠。

    “铮——”

    。

    黑铁长刀出鞘。

    陈然身上的气息，在这一瞬间发生了翻天覆地的变化。
content_en:
On the outskirts of the ghost market, there is a dark street corner.

    Several men huddled in the shadows were staring at a figure not far away.

    "Boss, this guy is very handsome, and he definitely has a lot of stuff!" A thin monkey-like man lowered his voice, his eyes full of greed, "How about brothers follow up and give him..."

    A man wearing a mask next to him frowned slightly, seeming to be weighing his concerns.

    He is a local snake on the outskirts of this black market, the boss of the Green Snake Gang.

    "Something's wrong." Another older man next to him shook his head.

    "This kid dares to reveal such a huge fortune alone in the ghost market, and his pace is so steady, he might be a tough guy. We'd better be careful."

    The masked man sneered when he heard this: "Hard stubble? How tough can a young pretty boy be?"

    You can't do anything in the black market. This is the rule that exists to this day.

    But as soon as you step out of the black market, life and death are determined, and wealth is in the sky.

    So their gang, which makes a living by robbing money, came into being, and today's goal seems a bit unusual.

    Seeing the young man leaving the door of the black market, the masked man spoke:

    "Go, follow. "

    After hearing what the boss said, several Green Snake Gang gangsters immediately followed him excitedly.

    The few eyeliners who stayed on the spot looked at each other and saw a hint of doubt in each other's eyes. They decided to stay put and follow the situation from a distance.

    …

    Chen Ran's footsteps were neither urgent nor slow, echoing in the empty tunnel.

    Five figures jumped out of the darkness, flanking him from both sides, blocking Chen Ran in a dead end filled with water.

    The leader is Cui Hai, the boss of the Green Snake Gang.

    He was holding a thick-backed ghost-headed sword in his hand, his face was sinister, and his eyes were filled with undisguised greed and murderous intent.

    Behind him were four minions holding sharp knives, staring intently at the cloth bag on Chen Ran's waist.

    "Run, why don't you run? "

    Cui Hai sneered again and again, and patted the thick palm with the ghost head sword.

    "Boy, are you unfamiliar? If you dare to reveal such a huge wealth in the ghost market, you won't even risk your life. "

    Chen Ran stopped.

    He turned around slowly.

    The large bamboo hat covered most of his face.

    “Hand over all the banknotes on your body and the things on your back. I'm in a good mood today, so I'll leave you with your whole body. "

    Cui Hai spat, pointed the tip of the knife directly at Chen Ran's face, and spoke in an extremely arrogant tone.

    The skinny monkey-looking guy next to him looked Chen Ran up and down and laughed lewdly.

    "Boss, I think this kid has tender skin and tender flesh. Why not strip him naked and sell them a few times before sending him on his way..."

    The words have not yet finished.

    Chen Ran sighed slowly.

    "Oh, this world. "

    Chen Ran thinks he is not a good person, but he is definitely not that evil.

    No wonder the people within the imperial court were in turmoil, and even this kind of murderous and swindling business dared to be done at the feet of the capital.

    It is conceivable that internal corruption has reached the extreme level now. The black market must have said hello, and there will be no police to take care of it.

    But it's not without its benefits. At least it's certain that no one is in charge of this area.

    He stretched out his right hand and untied the torn linen cloth from his back.

    "I am worried about buying this knife and spending all my savings. "

    Chen Ran's palm firmly grasped the rough handle of the black iron sword.

    "Since you are rushing to send money, I won't be polite. "

    "Seeking death! "

    Cui Hai was furious.

    The energy and blood of the eighth-level warrior exploded instantly, and the muscles all over his body became tangled.

    He held the Ghost Head Sword with both hands, kicked the ground with both legs, and pounced on Chen Ran like a tiger descending from a mountain.

    The ghost-headed knife struck Chen Ran's head with a shrill sound of wind.

    The sword's power was extremely fierce and he didn't hold back at all.

    At the same time, the other four minions also cooperated flawlessly. They brandished short knives and long thorns, blocking all Chen Ran's escape routes from four different directions, and went straight to the vital point.

    Facing the deadly siege of five people, Chen Ran stood still, motionless.

    Until Cui Hai's ghost-headed sword was about to smash the bamboo hat on his head.

    "Zheng——"

    .

    The long black iron sword was unsheathed.

    The aura on Chen Ran's body changed drastically at this moment.
title_en: Chapter 24 The black market touches people’s hearts, is Lin Shen going crazy? ! (3k)
